The largest distributor and supplier of medical-surgical supplies and healthcare products in the United States is Cardinal Health, alongside McKesson Corporation and Medline Industries, which together dominate the massive healthcare logistics and product supply chain. [](https://www.advacarepharma.com/en/who-is-the-largest-supplier-of-medical-supplies)

- **Cardinal Health:** Serves over 90% of U.S. hospitals and thousands of healthcare clinics and pharmacies with broad consumable and pharmaceutical distribution.

- **McKesson:** Operates as the largest distributor of wholesale medical-surgical supplies and pharmaceuticals across North America. [](https://www.mckesson.com/medical-supplies/)

- **Medline Industries:** Acts as the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical-surgical products, providing hundreds of thousands of individual hospital items

[](https://www.globaldata.com/companies/top-companies-by-sector/healthcare/global-companies-by-marketed-products/)

- **Global Manufacturers:** Companies like Medtronic, Becton Dickinson (BD), and Johnson & Johnson lead globally in producing specific medical devices and consumable goods. [](https://www.advacarepharma.com/en/who-is-the-largest-manufacturer-of-medical-supplies)
